digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer discovery
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a local checkout encounter broken internal cross-references in CLI-served guides because they use consumer-relative paths like `review-policy.md` and `../CONTRIBUTING.md` that do not resolve for repo-less users.

The required commit-trailer format (`EXPECTED_FORMAT` from `verify_commit.py`) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in `rebar verify-commit-ticket --help` with no pointers to it elsewhere.

Packaged author guides must repoint all dangling references using two conventions: sibling guides as `rebar explain <topic>` commands and repo-only docs as canonical hosted URLs (`https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/…`).

A new packaged guide `commit-ticket-trailer.md` must be registered in `AUTHOR_GUIDES` registry and served via `rebar explain commit-trailer` and MCP `explain_guide` tool, quoting `EXPECTED_FORMAT` verbatim.

A link-resolution guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide or MCP criterion rendering contains consumer-relative paths—only URLs, anchors, or `rebar explain` commands are allowed.
All MCP tool docstrings and help text must list all registered guides including `commit-trailer` so discovery and documentation stay synchronized.
